items.text: All final-year students must register for the internship briefing by 2026-08-15. Attendance will be checked.
Please complete the hostel verification form with your name and roll number before Friday.
Lab attendance is compulsory tomorrow at 9 AM. Students absent without approval will lose internal marks.
Students who finished the database assignment must reply DONE in the class poll by 5 PM today.
You may register for the optional design workshop if you would like to attend this Saturday.
Semester examination fee payment closes on 2026-09-01. Submit the receipt to the office after payment.
Attached is the Unit 3 question bank for Operating Systems. Revise scheduling, deadlocks, and memory management.
Today's compiler design notes cover lexical analysis, parsing, and symbol tables for the midterm revision.
Mock exam paper: answer the questions on normalization, transactions, and indexing. Use it for practice.
The syllabus for Unit 4 lists finite automata, regular expressions, and context-free grammars.
Good morning everyone. Have a great week!
Student discount available at the campus cafe this weekend. Show your ID for ten percent off.
The library-book return deadline has been extended. Students who already returned their books need take no action.
Can someone share yesterday's cafeteria menu photo?
Reminder only: the department already confirmed that there are no classes tomorrow.
